result.excerpt:
The page that gives an overview of submitting releases to Discogs is the help-centre article **"Overview Of Submission Guidelines For Releases"**:

https://support.discogs.com/hc/en-us/articles/360004016474-Overview-Of-Submission-Guidelines-For-Releases

It sits under *Discogs > Database & Contributing > Database Guidelines*, credited to Discogs Community Support and dated March 31, 2026.

**Basic Guidelines**
- Have the exact release in front of you when entering it into the database.
- Only enter or change information you can cite a trustworthy source for — stick to provable facts.
- Make sure every artist and label you enter links to the correct page; search for Artist Name Variations and use the ANV function to link them up.
- Capitalize the first letter of every word in names and titles.
- Follow the "Quick Start Guide For New Contributors" for your first few submissions.
- Refer to the full guidelines below for anything you are unsure of.
- Ask in the Help Forum if you get stuck, and be polite and friendly to others.

**Overview Of General Information** — points to three further resources: "Contributing to Discogs", the "Quick Start Guide For New Contributors", and the "Database Glossary".

**Full Guidelines** — the article links out to detailed pages for each topic: General Rules; Artist; Title; Label / Catalog Number; Barcode And Other Identifiers; Format (also the Formats List); Country; Release Date; Genres / Styles; Credits (also the Credits List); Release Notes; Tracklisting; Images; Updating A Release; Remove Release; Master Release; Merge Release; Updating An Artist Profile; Updating A Label Profile; Voting Guidelines; Contributor Improvement Program (CIP).
